title: Disability accommodations
summary: Student Disability Services (SDS) works with students individually to determine accommodations for learning and campus life. Start with the registration steps linked on the official page.
next_step: Open the official SDS page and follow its registration link.
verification: Official page reviewed; curated paraphrase, not a live feed
campus: Primarily Ithaca; confirm program eligibility with the office
summary_zh: 学生残障服务办公室（SDS）会与学生逐一沟通，确定学习与校园生活所需的合理便利。官方页面提供开始注册的步骤。
next_step_zh: 打开 SDS 官方页面，按其中的注册链接开始。

title: Getting started with SDS
summary: The SDS FAQ explains disability support and access barriers. It says some historic campus buildings may lack features such as elevators; arrangements depend on individual needs.
next_step: Read the FAQ and contact SDS about your specific access needs.
verification: Official page reviewed; curated paraphrase, not a live feed
campus: Primarily Ithaca; confirm program eligibility with the office
title_zh: 开始使用 SDS 服务
summary_zh: SDS 常见问题介绍残障支持与校园通行障碍。部分历史建筑可能缺少电梯等设施，具体安排取决于个人需要。
next_step_zh: 阅读常见问题，并联系 SDS 说明具体的无障碍需要。

title: International student advising
summary: International Services recommends opening a ticket for advice in most cases. Advising is available in person and on Zoom. Cornell Tech students are directed to Student & Academic Affairs.
next_step: Open Get Advice to submit a ticket or find the current appointment options.
verification: Official page reviewed; curated paraphrase, not a live feed
campus: Primarily Ithaca; confirm program eligibility with the office
summary_zh: International Services 建议大多数咨询先提交工单，也提供线下及 Zoom 咨询。Cornell Tech 学生应联系 Student & Academic Affairs。
next_step_zh: 打开官方咨询页面，提交工单或查看当前的预约方式。

title: Counseling and mental health support
summary: Cornell Health’s Counseling & Psychological Services (CAPS) offers drop-in consultation, individual counseling, and group counseling.
next_step: Open the official CAPS page to review current care and appointment options.
verification: Official page reviewed; curated paraphrase, not a live feed
campus: Primarily Ithaca; confirm program eligibility with the office
summary_zh: Cornell Health 的心理咨询服务（CAPS）提供即时咨询、个人心理咨询与团体心理咨询。
next_step_zh: 打开 CAPS 官方页面，查看当前的服务与预约方式。
